Number 7 represents the breathtaking and the miraculous. Because ‘‘Life’’ itself is a miracle, it is colors, textures, living, and nature in the flesh. It is the most unexpected becoming real. title: Türkan No/3 Ambre - 100mL
body_html:
Are you ready for a story that you'll never get bored of and a magical journey that will last a lifetime?

We all deeply feel the power, sanctity, and enchantment that the number three bestows upon our lives throughout history. Three is like an inviolable number etched into the innermost depths of our hearts. As we watch life dance in all its contradictions, there's always a mysterious third player among us. Nothing is purely black or white. There's always a third choice, a third perspective, a third thought, and a hidden third path; just like the beginning, middle, and end of a tale.

Türkan's new No/3 fragrance embraces you at the outset with the scents of fresh red fruits. Just like the first spark of love, the deep love and harmony between these scents draws you into a magical world from the first moment. Your first meeting with the protagonists of the story will be an unforgettable moment. And after you understand the story of the main characters, you start wandering among the branches of the tale. Each detail unfolds like individual leaves, and the alluring dance of leather, earthly vetiver, and patchouli begins. While wondering where this dance will lead, you find yourself drawn deeper... because now you will be burning with the desire to know how the story ends. That's exactly the case with No/3 AMBRE, carefully designed for those who perceive and are drawn to mysteries...

And finally, as you approach the peak and inevitable end of the tale, the curtain of mystery unveils. The protagonists of the conclusion emerge in the third layer of this captivating tale, coming to life in your mind, with the enchanting allure of amber and the irresistible charm of moss, as if they were real.

Türkan No/3 AMBRE is not just a fragrance, but also a source of inspiration and enchantment. This scent envelops you and draws you into another world. It's as if gravity disappears, and you find yourself in an atmosphere where your spirit soars. Other scents fade into the background as they envy its allure. It's like being in a celestial garden you never want to leave, continuing your life with the feeling of "I could stay here forever."

The enchanting power of 3 is now in the TÜRKAN bottle.

title: Türkan No/10 Noblesse - 100mL
body_html:
It is the most desirable, the most fragrant.

No/10 NOBLESSE is one of the scents that deserves the crown the most in the perfume kingdom. It has no choice but to be noble and make you feel noble when you wear it.

The number 10 is a combination of singleness and doubleness. It is as human as it is universal and spiritual. Your inner voice that will carry you forward in life and all your desires that you do not want to suppress came together in the bottle of No/10 NOBLESSE, inspired by this perfect number. This blend, which you will resort to while discovering your own truth, which will lead you to the absolute truth, is the most innocent but most seductive state of being addicted.

No/10 NOBLESSE not only wraps your skin, it also tries to understand it. Every essence that deserves to be included in its rich blend chats with your skin, listens, and wants to agree with it before conquering it. Your sense of smell, your body, your skin will never be able to resist his tongue. You want to understand it and learn its language. Where it came from, what it went through, how it was bottled… Just like when you meet someone in a new place and your desire to discover it… No/10 NOBLESSE, which will surprise you every time in a familiar game, is for those who are not afraid of commitment and know that nobility comes not only from ancestry but also from courage. .

The seductive power of 10 is now in the TÜRKAN bottle.

title: Türkan No/6 Charme - 100mL
body_html:
If you could smell true beauty, what would you name it?

No/6 CHARME is bottled with precision for those who seek beauty in balance. It was created for those who want to emphasize the power of beauty without hesitation in today's world where smelling good is not enough.

You may have come across the most beautiful flower in the world, and if its scent does not blow your mind, that flower will not be unforgettable for you, it will only "exist". Let's not forget that the biggest weapon of a flower is its fragrance. We combined only the floral essences that attract bees without hesitation and try to make more room for themselves without disturbing the balance of nature in the notes of No/6 CHARME.

We chose to call it No/6 CHARME because only such a perfume could come together with the number 6, which represents absolute balance and love. The number 6 is associated with a star consisting of two interlocking equilateral triangles. The first triangle represents the energies falling from the sky to the ground, while the other represents the energies rising from the earth to the sky. In other words, the superiority of the spirit over matter and the superiority of matter over spirit are together. The number 6, which can carry so much power, will of course serve absolute balance and true beauty.

The balancing power of 6 is now in the TÜRKAN bottle.

title: Türkan No/9 Mystique - 100mL
body_html:
An inspiring mysterious fragrance feast.

The constantly reminding notes of No/9 MYSTIQUE will remind you how privileged you are. While this unique blend makes you even more mysterious in the eyes of everyone, the number of people who really want to get to know you will increase. Get ready to be the center of attention.

The more we try to explain No/9 MYSTIQUE, the more we get lost in it. But if we tried to describe it in one word, it would definitely be "inspiration". The mystery behind this inspiration is actually not far from us. The number 9, which has found a respectable place in all cultures starting from the mythology of this geography, is seen as the beginning of the whole literary creation process. All you have to do is smell it to understand that the 9 fairies of inspiration come to life again in a single bottle. 9 floors, 9 clouds, 9 moons, 9 knots, 9 knights, 9 worlds… It's almost as if our universe is convinced that 9 is the most appropriate number to achieve perfection. In this pursuit of perfection, we could not ignore the influence of number 9 and named one of our most assertive scents.

 The inspiring power of 9 is now in the TÜRKAN bottle.

title: Türkan No/2 Équilibre - 100mL
body_html:
Your skin deserves to fall in love too.

Life and the universe itself are built on dualities. Everything has an opposite as well as a complement. If it is a perfume that will tell you, suit you and complete you, there is no better choice than No/2 EQUILIBRE. Giving your skin the most amazing fragrance it has ever worn will be the best gift you can give to your soul.

Before you sniff the No/2 EQUILIBRE, ask yourself: Am I ready to fall in love? Because the adventure you will experience will be a lifelong passion beyond a few days' getaway. You will get so used to feeling the freshness, freshness, peace and warmth of the sun around you for 365 days that you will feel incomplete every day you do not start with it.

The No/2 EQUILIBRE is there to complete you. You will find everything that you cannot see when you look in the mirror, but that your skin desires, in this blend. Imagine closing your eyes in a cool pool during the summer in the Mediterranean when the sky turns red. While a few melodies of your favorite song caress your ears from behind, the scent of this very special perfume is strong enough to hide you at that moment. Immerse yourself in the Notes of No/2 EQUILIBRE. Be sure that he will respond to you with an unforgettable symphony.

The complementary power of 2 is now in the TÜRKAN bottle.
